# InlineCitation

> Inline multi-source citation with a keyboard-accessible preview and source navigation.

This file matches the installed `inline-citation` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/inline-citation.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/inline-citation.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `lucide-react@^1.47.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `button`
- `core`
- `live-status`
- `popover`
- `source-badge`

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/inline-citation-knobs`: `inlineCitationKnobs`, types `InlineCitationKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/inline-citation`: `citationLabel`, `InlineCitation`, `InlineCitationTrigger`, `InlineCitationFavicons`, `InlineCitationLabel`, `InlineCitationContent`, `InlineCitationNavigation`, `InlineCitationPrevious`, `InlineCitationNext`, `InlineCitationPosition`, `InlineCitationSource`, types `SourceReference`, `CitationLabelTemplates`, `InlineCitationProps`, `InlineCitationTriggerProps`, `InlineCitationFaviconsProps`, `InlineCitationLabelProps`, `InlineCitationContentProps`, `InlineCitationNavigationProps`, `InlineCitationPreviousProps`, `InlineCitationNextProps`, `InlineCitationPositionProps`, `InlineCitationSourceProps`

## Composition

### Source preview and navigation

These are also the built-in parts when children are omitted.

```tsx
<InlineCitation>
  <InlineCitationTrigger>
    <InlineCitationFavicons />
    <InlineCitationLabel />
  </InlineCitationTrigger>
  <InlineCitationContent>
    <InlineCitationNavigation>
      <InlineCitationPrevious />
      <InlineCitationNext />
      <InlineCitationPosition />
    </InlineCitationNavigation>
    <InlineCitationSource />
  </InlineCitationContent>
</InlineCitation>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import type { SourceReference } from "@/components/control-ui/inline-citation";
import { InlineCitation } from "@/components/control-ui/inline-citation";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

const sources = [
  {
    href: "https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/popover",
    title: "Popover — shadcn/ui",
    description: "Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.",
    faviconSrc: "https://ui.shadcn.com/favicon.ico",
  },
  {
    href: "https://base-ui.com/react/components/popover",
    title: "Popover — Base UI",
    description: "An accessible popup anchored to a trigger element.",
    faviconSrc: "https://base-ui.com/favicon.ico",
  },
  {
    href: "https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Popover_API",
    title: "Popover API — MDN",
    quote: "The Popover API provides developers with a standard, consistent, flexible mechanism for displaying popover content.",
  },
] satisfies SourceReference[];

export function InlineCitationExample() {
  return (
    <Text as="div" tone="foreground" className="mx-auto max-w-xl">
      A citation with several references stays compact in the answer, then opens a keyboard-accessible source preview
      <InlineCitation sources={sources} />. Each source keeps its own title, excerpt, and outbound link.
    </Text>
  );
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### inline-citation

- `--cui-inline-citation-trigger-radius`: `9999px`
- `--cui-inline-citation-trigger-background`: `oklch(from var(--muted) l c h / 0.55)`
- `--cui-inline-citation-trigger-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-inline-citation-trigger-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-inline-citation-trigger-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-inline-citation-trigger-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)`
- `--cui-inline-citation-trigger-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
